'''Project Iokath''' was a undertaken by a [[Unidentified Iokath species|species]], the name of which has been lost to history, in the millennia preceding the [[Manderon Period]].

==History==
[[File:Iokath_Surface.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The surface of Iokath upon the completion of the Project.]]
A species composed of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] had already spent multiple centuries designing, developing and perfecting weapons of mass destruction, testing them on dozens of unsuspecting worlds throughout the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] without any sign of morality.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|History of Iokath: Entry 1}}</ref> Project Iokath was even more ambitious, with the goal to fabricate an expandable and adaptable home for the entire species that was also secure against any outside force.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|History of Iokath: Entry 4}}</ref> To that end, they picked an [[Iokath system's star|unremarkable star]] in the Unknown Regions and demolished every orbital body in its [[Iokath system/Legends|system]] down to the last asteroid, salvaging them for core elements. Those were used to create a massive self-sustaining ecosphere that completely engulfed the star, using all of its energy output. The massive habitat was named [[Iokath]] and once completed it allowed no light from its star outside, the entire system became undetectable to the rest of the galaxy. Even then, the exterior defenses of the sphere made the inside biome virtually unassailable, while the inside biomes could be altered and expanded as needed, giving Iokath creators complete control over its environment.<ref>{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Iokath}}</ref>
